subject.title: feat(model): support one-turn chat model override

question: Should one-turn model overrides be accepted as inline `/model <provider/model> <message>` syntax, an explicit `chat.send.model` field, or a `sessions.patch` next-turn scope?
rationale: The branch chooses inline Gateway parsing, but the canonical issue asks for an explicit public contract and the choice affects authorization, protocol compatibility, session state, response metadata, and provider/model routing.

options.title: Define the API first
options.body: Keep this PR open but pause merge until maintainers choose the public one-turn override contract and the branch is aligned to it.

options.title: Accept inline slash syntax
options.body: Allow inline `/model` as the product surface, but require it to use existing directive authorization and include missing proof and reporting behavior before merge.

options.title: Move to explicit chat/session fields
options.body: Rework the feature around `chat.send.model` or `sessions.patch` next-turn scope with protocol, docs, and upgrade tests.

recommendation.title: Define the API first
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but pause merge until maintainers choose the public one-turn override contract and the branch is aligned to it.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent path history most strongly ties this API/product boundary to steipete's session, Gateway, and model-selection work.
